reviewItem.question: Does "With the default enablement of KVStoreMesh, if you use external workloads, ensure that your cluster has a Cluster name and ID specified before upgrading" mean a change to migration:cilium|name=kvstoremesh-cluster-name-id (migration-required)?

proposed.statement: KVStoreMesh is now enabled by default; clusters using external workloads must set a cluster name and ID before upgrading, or explicitly opt out of KVStoreMesh.
